key_insight: Bayesian data assimilation can calibrate RANS turbulence-model parameters and inlet conditions from noisy 3D flow MRI, improving mean-flow reconstruction while quantifying uncertainty.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical route to turn clinical/experimental flow MRI into physics-based flow predictions for device design and validation in complex internal flows.
method: Infer posterior distributions for RANS model parameters and inlet boundary conditions
Assimilate noisy 3D MRI velocity data from the FDA nozzle geometry
Use two differentiable algebraic closures based on mean shear rate magnitude and turbulence kinetic energy
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that the inferred models reconstruct measured mean velocities without overfitting and yield uncertainty estimates for the parameters.
watch_item: The approach depends on differentiable RANS closures, so extending it to more complex or non-smooth turbulence models may be implementation-sensitive.
paper_title: Data assimilation of flow MRI data into RANS models with algebraic closures
